_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: First exterior window RP spec. Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish for previously painted exterior window units. Context prefix XWRP (eXterior Window RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_XWIN_* is NC exterior window (51 tasks). TSK_WIN_* is NC interior window (29 tasks). TSK_WNRP_* is interior window RP (42 tasks). TSK_TRRP_* is exterior trim RP. TSK_DRRP_* is exterior door RP. XWRP avoids all collisions. Verified: zero TSK_XWRP_* IDs exist in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window — small (glass area < 6 SF)
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_WINDOW_EXT_NC. Same physical assembly in RP context. Size bucket S. Covers awning, casement, fixed window types in small bucket.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window — medium (glass area 6-15 SF)
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_WINDOW_EXT_NC. Calibration baseline for production rates. Most common size bucket.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window — large (glass area > 15 SF)
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_WINDOW_EXT_NC. Includes bay/bow windows (forced into L regardless of glass area). Bay/bow counted as 1 EA each — window_type modifier drives elevated per-EA rate.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_XWIN_* is NC exterior window (SF_WINDOW_EXT_NC_v1, 51 tasks). TSK_WIN_* is NC interior window. TSK_WNRP_* is interior window RP. TSK_TRRP_* is exterior trim RP. TSK_DRRP_* is exterior door RP. TSK_XWRP_* is unique for exterior window RP. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — XWRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_XWRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. ALL tasks in this combined RP spec use the XWRP_ prefix — both RP-new tasks and tasks adapted from NC exterior window spec. Direct NC task transfers are re-issued under TSK_XWRP_* for prefix consistency.

expected_modules.notes: Glass masking (mandatory, 30-40% of total time for TDL). Hardware removal. Weatherstrip protection. Sill protection. Casing protection. Siding masking (spray only). Equipment setup. Landscape/hardscape protection (RP-specific). Mostly DIRECT transfers from NC MOD_XWIN_SETUP.

RP-specific: condition inspection (DSD rating, photograph defects), adhesion test (ASTM D3359), chalk test (white cloth rub — exterior-specific), moisture check (sill/bottom rail/end grain), glazing compound assessment (older wood windows), rot probe (press/probe for soft wood), sash operation test (pre-paint). Assessment maps to 'prep' phase. FIXED time tasks. NO coating ID test needed for exterior windows (RC-003 — exterior paint is predominantly acrylic latex).

Power wash per elevation (replaces TSP hand-wash from interior), degloss/scuff sound existing paint, scrape/feather failing/peeling paint, chalk remediation (chalk-binding primer), mildew/algae treatment (biocide), caulk assess/repair per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol, glazing repair (scope-limited <25% of perimeter), wood hardener on surface-softened areas, scuff exposed aluminum/clean exposed vinyl. Condition-driven task activation. EA-based rates with size/type/muntin/height/condition/RRP modifiers.

State-driven primer selection: acrylic stain-block primer for general RP (exposed wood areas), chalk-binding primer for SS_EXT_CHALKING, corrosion-inhibiting spot primer for exposed aluminum, PVC bonding spot primer for exposed vinyl. Conditional on substrate state — skip prime for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT with verified adhesion. Brush/spray variants. Modified from NC: NC primes full surface (bare substrate); RP primes spot or full depending on condition.

Fine-finish interstage protocol: inspect coat, sand between coats (QT3 none, QT4 220-grit, QT5 hand-sand 220/320), patch/repair defects, spot coat, clean dust. Runs between each coat pair. Transfers DIRECT from NC — identical once surface is prepped and primed.

Finish coat application — brush or spray. 2 coats standard (QT3-QT5). Sash sequence for double-hung blocking prevention (reversal, dry posture, periodic movement, channel lubrication) transfers DIRECT from NC. Fine-finish coating systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). 1/16-inch glass lap for weather seal.

Protection teardown (glass masking, sill, casing, siding, hardware reinstall, weatherstrip reinstall). Glass scraping after cure (razor scrape excess paint beyond 1/16-inch glass lap). Landscape/hardscape protection removal. Equipment cleanup. Customer walkthrough (RP-specific). Cure advisory (7-14 days before fully closing sashes). Sash break at 24/48 hrs to prevent adhesion bond. Site debris cleanup (scraping debris collection).

Shared exterior lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_EXT_META.FLAG.PRE_1978 = true. Per-elevation setup: 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Shared across all exterior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec. Windows are HIGH RISK for lead paint (friction surfaces on operable sashes are the #1 residential lead dust generator).

paintscope_keys.description: Count of small exterior windows (S bucket, glass area < 6 SF). Size modifier 0.60x.
paintscope_keys.notes: From NC exterior window spec. S bucket smaller than interior S bucket.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of medium exterior windows (M bucket, glass area 6-15 SF). Baseline 1.00x.
paintscope_keys.notes: Calibration baseline for all per-window rates.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of large exterior windows (L bucket, glass area > 15 SF). Size modifier 1.50x. Includes bay/bow.
paintscope_keys.notes: Bay and bow windows forced into L regardless of glass area.

paintscope_keys.description: Glass masking count — typically equals total window count. Drives masking rate.
Window type per project (or per-window override): awning, casement, double_hung, fixed, bay, bow.
paintscope_keys.notes: PRIMARY cost driver alongside size bucket. double_hung=1.00x baseline, fixed=0.50x, bay=2.00x, bow=2.50x.

paintscope_keys.description: Window cladding type: wood, aluminum_clad, vinyl_clad. Drives primer selection on exposed substrate.
paintscope_keys.notes: Per-project with per-window override possible. In RP, cladding determines primer chemistry for exposed areas only.

paintscope_keys.description: Muntin/grille type: none, gbg, sdl, tdl. SECONDARY cost driver for masking and painting labor.
paintscope_keys.notes: TDL = 1.75x on application + masking. GBG = no impact. SDL = 1.25x.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag: Low-E glass present. Prohibits liquid mask (chemical damage to Low-E coating).
paintscope_keys.notes: Low-E = tape-and-film masking ONLY. No liquid mask. Follows NC constraint.

paintscope_keys.description: Per-window access tier: ground (1.00x), ladder (1.35x), scaffold (1.60x).
paintscope_keys.notes: 3-tier model from NC. Per-window attribute. HEIGHT IS A MAJOR MODIFIER for exterior windows. Applied to ALL per-window tasks.

paintscope_keys.description: Exterior substrate state: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_CHALKING, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_PEELING. Worst-state-wins per v1.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP and other exterior RP specs. Maps to condition scale: GOOD=SOUND_PAINT, FAIR=CHALKING, POOR=FAILING_PAINT/PEELING. Drives primer selection and prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across all exterior RP specs. Project-level flag. Pre-1978 exterior paint is almost always lead. Windows are HIGH RISK (friction surfaces).

paintscope_keys.description: Landscape/ground protection area below window work zones. Drop cloth or poly.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with exterior trim and siding RP specs. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

paintscope_keys.description: Walkway/patio protection area below window work zones. Drop cloth runners.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with exterior trim RP. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

paintscope_keys.description: Total elevation count. Drives per-elevation fixed tasks (power wash, RRP containment setup/teardown).

quality_tier.notes: QT3 minimum for windows (fine-finish scope). QT2 excluded — exterior windows are visible architectural elements. QT modifiers use GLOBAL values: QT3=1.0x, QT4=1.3x, QT5=1.5x (NOT door-specific overrides).

application_method.notes: Brush is PRIMARY — precision required for 1/16-inch glass lap, sash sequence, cutting in around glass. Spray is CONDITIONAL (whole-house spray context only — adds masking overhead). Roll is NOT valid for windows. spray_backroll not applicable.

sheen.notes: Semi-gloss is traditional exterior window sheen. Satin acceptable at QT3. Gloss at QT5 only. Flat/matte/eggshell NOT valid for exterior windows per doctrine.

phase.notes: Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. 'apply' omitted from values because spec uses prime/finish directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA for per-window tasks (primary). SF for landscape/hardscape protection. LF for siding masking. FIXED for per-elevation tasks (power wash, RRP containment) and per-project tasks (assessment, customer walkthrough). No EA_ROOM — exterior does not use room concept.

substrate_state.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states — same as SF_TRIM_EXT_RP. All input states converge to painted output per selected sheen. Worst-state-wins per v1.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x. Note: FAIR maps to both chalking and localized failing paint. POOR maps to active delamination. The research condition_drivers assign this mapping.

consumable_category.notes: All categories valid for exterior window RP. 'tool' covers assessment kit and glass scraper. 'prep' covers deglosser, biocide, glazing compound. 'protection' covers landscape tarps, drop cloths, poly sheeting.

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven RP primers (chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block, corrosion-inhibiting, PVC bonding). Finish = fine-finish QT-driven systems. Specialty = biocide, wood hardener.

yield_uom.notes: EA for per-window consumables. SF for coverage-based consumables. GAL for product yield.

protection_level.notes: full_mask for glass masking and siding masking. item_mask for hardware and weatherstrip. light_mask for sill and casing. edge_only/full_cover for landscape/hardscape. full_containment for RRP.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x), QT4=selective_multiplier (1.3x on qt_scaled tasks), QT5=selective_multiplier (1.5x). Condition modifiers: GOOD=baseline, FAIR=selective_multiplier (1.5x on prep), POOR=selective_multiplier (2.0x on prep).

surface_ids.primary_surface_note: Representative for exterior frame/sash assembly. Additional primary surfaces: window_sash_ext, window_muntin_ext, window_jamb_extension_ext, window_stool_apron_ext.
surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs from NC exterior window spec. window_frame_sash_ext: frame + sash assembly. window_glass: masking only (not painted — 1/16-inch lap line). ext_trim_window_casing: casing covered by SF_TRIM_EXT_RP. siding_field: protection only (spray masking). window_interior: SF_WINDOW_INT_RP scope boundary.

zone_ids.notes: Glass pane masking. MANDATORY regardless of method. Tape-and-film or liquid mask per Low-E status and muntin type. 1/16-inch glass lap for weather seal. Transfers DIRECT from NC.
Hardware REMOVED (not masked). Labeled bags per window. Reinstall after final coat dry. Fixed windows: skip. RP: hardware may have paint buildup requiring scoring before removal.
Weatherstripping removal or deep-tape. NEVER paint weatherstripping. Operable windows only. Transfers DIRECT from NC.
Tape and paper over finished exterior sill. In RP, sill is almost always already finished. Transfers DIRECT from NC.
Light tape at casing-to-frame junction when casing is already finished. In RP, casing is almost always already finished. Transfers DIRECT from NC.
Protect finished siding around window perimeter. Paper and tape. Spray only. Transfers DIRECT from NC.

RP-SPECIFIC: landscape and ground protection below windows. Catches scraping debris, power wash runoff, and paint drips. Drop cloth or poly. Upgrades to full_cover for spray. RRP: 6-mil poly extending 10 ft from structure. Shared with exterior trim RP.
RP-SPECIFIC: walkway/patio surfaces below window work areas. Drop cloth runners. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP. Shared with exterior trim RP.

RP-SPECIFIC: EPA RRP Rule containment. 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Required when disturbing lead paint on pre-1978 structures. Per-elevation setup. Shared across all exterior RP specs.

material_system_prefix.notes: Finish systems are existing/shared fine-finish systems (QT3/QT4/QT5). Exterior RP primer systems: acrylic stain-block for general RP (exposed wood areas on FAIR/POOR), chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, DTM corrosion-inhibiting for exposed aluminum, PVC bonding for exposed vinyl. Primer selection is state-driven (condition) + cladding-driven (material). Some primer systems may already exist from SF_TRIM_EXT_RP — Materials Manager to verify and reuse. No VinylSafe IR-reflective system needed for RP (VinylSafe is NC-specific for factory vinyl).

shared_rp_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
shared_rp_consumables.notes: Shared across RP specs. Chemical degloss for existing paint.

shared_rp_consumables.name: RP Assessment Kit (Adhesion + Chalk Test)
shared_rp_consumables.notes: Shared across RP specs. Cross-hatch cutter, tape (ASTM D3359), white cloth (chalk rub test), mineral spirits, moisture meter.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Mildewcide / Biocide Solution
shared_rp_consumables.notes: Shared across exterior RP specs. For mildew/algae treatment on damp exterior surfaces.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Wood Hardener / Consolidant
shared_rp_consumables.notes: Shared across exterior RP specs. For surface-softened wood at sill/bottom rail.

proposed_consumables.name: Glazing Compound (Acrylic or DAP)
proposed_consumables.justification: Window-specific RP consumable for spot repair of failed glazing compound on older wood windows. Exterior glazing repair more common than interior due to weather exposure. May already be proposed in SF_WINDOW_INT_RP — Materials Manager to verify.

proposed_consumables.name: Glass Scraper (Single-Edge Razor)
proposed_consumables.justification: For post-cure glass cleaning. Razor scrape excess paint beyond 1/16-inch glass lap line. Used in both NC and RP window specs. Transfers from NC implicitly but never formalized.

proposed_consumables.name: Carbide Scraper (Exterior Paint Scraping)
proposed_consumables.justification: Exterior-specific tool for scraping failing/peeling paint. More aggressive than sandpaper. Carbide blades last longer than steel on exterior paint buildup. Shared with exterior trim and siding RP specs.

proposed_consumables.name: 6-Mil Poly Sheeting (RRP Containment)
proposed_consumables.justification: EPA RRP Rule requires 6-mil poly for ground containment when disturbing lead paint. Per-elevation quantity. Shared across all exterior RP specs.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Standard RP sequence for FAIR/POOR condition exterior windows requiring primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Most common RP round for windows with chalking, failing paint, or peeling. Prime coat is state-driven (chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block, or cladding-specific spot primer).

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only. GOOD condition, no prime needed — sound paint with adhesion verified.
proposed_rounds.notes: Skip prime when adhesion test passes, existing paint is sound. Most common exterior window repaint scenario (cosmetic refresh, color change).

proposed_rounds.description: 2-coat prime + 2 finish coats. QT5 FAIR/POOR condition — maximum primer coverage.
proposed_rounds.notes: QT5 adds second primer coat for maximum coverage on degraded exterior surfaces. Per SF_TRIM_EXT_RP pattern (2-coat primer at QT5).

proposed_rounds.description: 2-coat prime + 2 finish coats. QT5 GOOD condition — second prime for coverage.
proposed_rounds.notes: QT5 second primer even on sound paint for maximum system build. Following exterior trim RP QT5 pattern.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for acrylic stain-block primer on previously painted exterior window surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Previously painted surfaces absorb less primer than bare substrate. Higher coverage per gallon than NC primer.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for chalk-binding primer on chalking exterior window surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Chalk-binding primers are thicker bodied — lower coverage per gallon than standard acrylic primer.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for DTM spot primer on exposed aluminum cladding.
proposed_profiles.notes: Spot priming only — much smaller area than full prime. Coverage expressed per EA (fraction of total window surface).

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for PVC bonding primer on exposed vinyl cladding.
proposed_profiles.notes: Spot priming only. Coverage expressed per EA.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for fine-finish enamel on repainted exterior window surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Similar to NC finish coverage on previously painted substrate. COV_XWIN_FINISH may be reusable — Materials Manager to evaluate.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared RP modifier. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x. Same values as interior RP and other exterior RP specs.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: Transfers from NC unchanged. S=0.60x, M=1.00x (baseline), L=1.50x. Applied per EA for all per-window tasks.
Transfers from NC unchanged. fixed=0.50x, awning=0.70x, casement=0.85x, double_hung=1.00x, bay=2.00x, bow=2.50x.
Transfers from NC unchanged. none=1.00x, gbg=1.00x, sdl=1.25x, tdl=1.75x.
Transfers from NC. 3-tier model: ground=1.00x, ladder=1.35x, scaffold=1.60x. Per-window attribute.

proposed_modifiers.notes: RRP modifier: no_rrp=1.00x, rrp_required=2.00x. Applied to prep tasks involving paint disturbance. Binary gate. Calibrated to 2.0x per established exterior RP pattern (RC-001).

prep_pool.formula: condition_modifier x rrp_modifier x access_modifier x window_type_modifier x muntin_modifier x size_modifier
prep_pool.max_theoretical: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x bow(2.50) x TDL(1.75) x L(1.50) = 42.0x
prep_pool.flag_note: Max theoretical is extreme and would never occur (RRP + scaffold + bow + TDL is unrealistic combination). Realistic worst case: POOR(2.0) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x DH(1.00) x no_muntin(1.00) x M(1.00) = 2.70x. With RRP: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x ground(1.00) x DH(1.00) x none(1.00) x M(1.00) = 4.00x. RRP doubles prep but is binary — it either applies or doesn't.

coating_pool.formula: qt_modifier x access_modifier x window_type_modifier x muntin_modifier x size_modifier
coating_pool.flag_note: Theoretical max inflated by bow(2.50) x TDL(1.75) combo which doesn't exist (bow windows don't have TDL). Realistic max: QT5(1.5) x ladder(1.35) x DH(1.00) x TDL(1.75) x M(1.00) = 3.54x. Well under 4.0x flag.

coordination_notes: Exterior window RP runs alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP which covers window casing. Caulk at frame-to-casing junction is THIS spec's responsibility.
Power wash ownership: per-elevation task. If power wash already performed by another spec on same elevation, skip. Cross-spec deduplication rule (U-003).
Landscape/hardscape protection zones shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP and SF_SIDING_*_EXT_RP. Protection setup owned by first spec in elevation sequence (U-004).
MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all exterior RP specs — do not duplicate RRP containment tasks. Per-elevation setup.
Height/access modifiers (FAC_EXT_ACCESS) are per-window attributes — one building may have ground-level and ladder/scaffold windows.
Siding masking zone (ext_siding_adjacent) needed for spray method only. If siding RP is also in scope, coordinate masking.
In RP, all adjacent surfaces (casing, sill, siding) are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory for BOTH spray and brush methods.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: Every TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 10: Every ITM_ marked 'existing' in resolution.json MUST use the exact registered ID
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior window repaint. Covers window frame, sash, muntins, stool/apron for all 3 cladding types (wood, aluminum-clad, vinyl-clad). No existing SF_ covers exterior window RP.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix XWRP for exterior window RP tasks (~63 tasks). Avoids collision with TSK_XWIN_* (NC exterior window, 51 tasks), TSK_WIN_* (NC interior window), TSK_WNRP_* (interior window RP), TSK_TRRP_* (exterior trim RP), TSK_DRRP_* (exterior door RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window Repaint Module Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New module prefix for 7 XWRP modules (setup, assessment, prep, prime, interstage, finish, cleanup) + shared MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window RP: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific round with conditional state-driven prime for FAIR/POOR condition. Not equivalent to ROUND_XWIN_PRIME_2FINISH (NC, substrate-driven prime).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window RP: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP GOOD condition round — skip prime when adhesion verified on sound exterior paint.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window RP: 2-Coat Prime + 2 Finish (QT5 FAIR/POOR)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT5 adds second primer coat for maximum coverage on degraded exterior surfaces. Following SF_TRIM_EXT_RP QT5 pattern.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window RP: 2-Coat Prime + 2 Finish (QT5 GOOD)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT5 second primer on sound paint for maximum system build.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer Coverage on Painted Exterior Window Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — primer on previously painted exterior windows differs from NC bare-substrate coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Coverage on Chalking Exterior Window Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Chalk-binding primers have distinct (lower) coverage rate due to thicker body.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Spot Primer Coverage on Exposed Aluminum Cladding
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Spot priming on aluminum cladding — distinct from full surface DTM primer in NC.

registry_additions_proposed.name: PVC Bonding Spot Primer Coverage on Exposed Vinyl Cladding
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Spot priming on vinyl cladding — distinct from full surface bonding primer in NC.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fine-Finish Enamel Coverage on Repainted Exterior Window Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific finish coverage. May reuse COV_XWIN_FINISH — Materials Manager to evaluate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: RRP Modifier for Exterior Window Prep Tasks
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific modifier: 2.0x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance when RRP required. Calibrated per established exterior RP pattern (RC-001). May share with FAC_TRRP_RRP / FAC_DRRP_RRP if generic FAC_EXT_RRP exists.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Carbide Scraper (Exterior Paint Scraping)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Exterior-specific tool for scraping failing/peeling paint. More durable than steel on exterior paint buildup. Shared across exterior RP specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: 6-Mil Poly Sheeting (RRP Containment)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: EPA RRP Rule requires 6-mil poly for ground containment. Per-elevation quantity. May already exist from trim RP — Materials Manager to verify.
